# config.toml settings

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_config_docs.py from
src/wgsextract_cli/core/settings_schema.py; run `just regen`. -->

WGS Extract reads its settings from config.toml: `wgsextract config` prints where it is and every setting's value, and `--config PATH` picks another file for one run. Command-line options override settings for a run.

Every value is checked when the file loads: a value of the wrong type, outside its range or not one of its choices stops the run with an error that names the setting and what it expects. An unknown setting is ignored with a warning that suggests the closest name.

## Settings

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allow_reference_downloads` | boolean | `false` | Allow first-use public reference/model downloads for commands with --download (hosts and request data: docs/privacy.md); no sample uploads |
| `input_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Default input BAM/CRAM or FASTQ file |
| `output_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Default output directory |
| `temp_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Optional volume for sort spills, GATK and realign staging |
| `atomic_outputs` | boolean | `false` | Publish completed main outputs by rename (changes tool provenance paths) |
| `reference_fasta` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to the reference genome FASTA |
| `reference_library` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Reference data directory (annotation data, gene maps, VEP caches) |
| `reference_genome_library` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folder holding only the reference genomes (FASTAs) and the files made from them, for reference_library (default: genomes/ in it) |
| `dataset_library` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Directory of user datasets, one folder per person or sample (formerly genome_library) |
| `cpu_threads` | integer or `auto` | `"auto"` | CPU threads: a positive integer for every stage, or auto (per-stage core-layout plan on Apple Silicon; all cores elsewhere) |
| `memory_limit` | string | `"auto"` | Memory limit per thread, e.g. 2G (auto: 25% of RAM split across threads) |
| `debug_mode` | boolean | `false` | Enable verbose debug logging |
| `quiet_mode` | boolean | `false` | Enable quiet mode (errors only) |
| `log_dir` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Opt-in directory for unique persistent DEBUG run logs and provenance; it keeps the newest 100 runs |
| `state_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folder for the last-run record and saved bug reports (report-issue); default: state/ in the data folder |
| `server_port` | integer, 0 to 65535 | `0` | Port `wgsextract serve` listens on at 127.0.0.1 (0: any free port) |
| `server_allowed_paths` | string or array of strings, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folders (a string or an array) `wgsextract serve` requests may read and write, besides dataset_library, reference_library, reference_genome_library and output_directory |
| `server_mcp_transport` | `stdio` or `http` | `"stdio"` | How `wgsextract serve --mcp` speaks MCP: stdio, or http (streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with a per-launch token; needs the optional 'mcp' package) |
| `server_mcp_port` | integer, 0 to 65535 | `0` | Port `wgsextract serve --mcp-transport http` listens on at 127.0.0.1 (0: any free port) |
| `server_max_jobs` | integer, at least 1 | `1` | Long `wgsextract serve` jobs that run at once; more wait in a queue |
| `keep_awake` | boolean | `false` | Best-effort sleep inhibition while commands run (opt-in) |
| `haplogrep_executable` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to the Haplogrep 3 executable or JAR |
| `dorado_executable` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to ONT's dorado executable for `basecall` |
| `native_aligners` | `auto` or `off` | unset | Apple Silicon: `align`/`realign` use wgse-bwa, wgse-bwa-mem2, wgse-bwa-mem3 and wgse-minimap2 when on PATH (auto, the default) or never (off); Linux: Bioconda's bwa-mem3 in place of bwa/bwa-mem2 |
| `output_profile` | `default` or `archive` or `calling` | `"default"` | `align`/`realign`: default keeps --format; archive selects lossless CRAM 3.1 (GATK 4.7+); calling selects compatible CRAM 3.0 |
| `prefer_native_gpu` | boolean | `false` | `align`/`realign`: prefer wgse-bwa's native GPU even above the RAM budget after normal sort step-down; retain explicit memory, otherwise cap default/config sort at 256M (may swap heavily) |
| `dense_suffix_array` | boolean | `false` | `align`/`realign`: wgse-bwa reads the reference's dense suffix-array file from `ref dense-sa` (opt-in; used only when wgse-bwa aligns; holds it in RAM, 0.8 GB for hs38) |
| `dorado_models_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folder `basecall` downloads Dorado models into (default: the wgsextract cache's dorado-models) |
| `mimalloc` | `auto` or `off` | unset | Apple Silicon: `vcf snp`/`vcf indel` run bcftools with WGS Extract's wgse-mimalloc allocator when it's installed (auto, the default) or never (off) |
| `baq` | boolean | `false` | `vcf snp`/`vcf indel`: enable heuristic base alignment quality (BAQ) in bcftools mpileup (slower; may reduce low-depth recall); off by default; see docs/variant-confidence.md |
| `reference_evidence` | `none` or `gvcf` | `"none"` | `vcf snp`/`vcf indel`/`vcf deepvariant`/`vcf gatk`/`vcf clair3`: also write a gVCF of reference evidence (bcftools.g.vcf.gz, deepvariant.g.vcf.gz, gatk.g.vcf.gz, clair3.g.vcf.gz) beside the variant VCF (gvcf), or not (none, the default); see docs/reference-evidence.md |
| `haplocheck_executable` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to the haplocheck executable or JAR |
| `report_gene_list` | string | unset | `report`: genes of the ClinVar section, a built-in list (acmg-sf-3.3, the default, or acmg-sf-3.2) or a TSV or BED file |
| `haplogrep_tree` | string | unset | Haplogrep 3 tree for mtDNA haplogroups: phylotree-fu-rcrs (default), phylotree-rcrs or mitotree-rcrs |
| `y_tree` | string | unset | Y haplogroup tree for `lineage y-haplogroup`: yfull (default), yfull_v10, ftdna, isogg or a [y_trees] id |
| `y_trees` | tables | unset | Your own Y haplogroup trees, one [y_trees.<id>] table each (see the Yleaf README) |
| `jar_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Directory for JAR tools |
| `vep_cache_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to VEP cache |
| `vep_engine` | `vep-rs` or `ensembl` | unset | Engine `vep run` annotates with: vep-rs (default) or ensembl |
| `pharmcat_directory` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Extracted PharmCAT pipeline release |
| `parabricks_image` | string | unset | NVIDIA Parabricks Docker image for GPU alignment and calling (default nvcr.io/nvidia/clara/clara-parabricks:4.8.0-1) |
| `deepvariant_image` | string | unset | DeepVariant Docker image for CPU calling (default google/deepvariant:1.10.0 on x64; local localhost/wgsextract-deepvariant:1.10.0-arm64 on Linux ARM64) |
| `deepvariant_native` | `auto` or `off` | unset | `vcf deepvariant` runs wgse-deepvariant (Apple Silicon, Linux x86-64) when it is on PATH (auto, the default) or never (off) |
| `deepvariant_weights` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folder of the weights wgse-deepvariant calls with (from its macos-deepvariant or linux-deepvariant release) |
| `deepvariant_ultima_image` | string | unset | DeepVariant Docker image with the ULTIMA model, for Ultima reads (default google/deepvariant:gh1100-ultima) |
| `deepvariant_ultima_gpu_image` | string | unset | DeepVariant GPU Docker image with the ULTIMA model, for `vcf deepvariant --gpu` on Ultima reads (default google/deepvariant:gh1100-ultima-gpu, pinned by digest) |
| `clair3_model` | string | unset | Clair3 ONT model for `vcf clair3`: a model directory or the name of one Clair3 bundles (default: chosen from the reads' basecaller metadata) |
| `clair3_gpu_image` | string | unset | Clair3 GPU Docker image for `vcf clair3 --gpu` (default hkubal/clair3:v2.0.5_gpu, pinned by digest) |
| `methylation_context` | `cpg` or `all` | `"cpg"` | `methylation pileup` context: cpg (CpG sites) or all (every cytosine) |
| `methylation_5hmc` | boolean | `false` | `methylation pileup`: also report 5hmC (Nanopore 5mCG_5hmCG models) |
| `methylation_combine_strands` | boolean | `true` | `methylation pileup`: sum both strands of each CpG into one row |
| `default_input_vcf` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Default input VCF file |
| `microarray_min_gq` | integer, at least 0 | `20` | Microarray minimum sample GQ (0 disables filtering) |
| `microarray_min_dp` | integer, at least 0 | `10` | Microarray minimum sample DP (0 disables filtering) |
| `microarray_assume_hom_ref` | boolean | `false` | Treat absent VCF markers on represented contigs as homozygous reference |
| `microarray_exclude_filtered` | boolean | `true` | Write microarray no-calls for VCF FILTER values other than PASS or . |
| `microarray_call_reasons` | boolean | `false` | Write a companion CombinedKit_reasons.tsv with explicit call/no-call reasons |
| `microarray_strand_ambiguous` | `keep` or `no-call` | `"keep"` | Keep or no-call known biallelic A/T and C/G input SNP sites |
| `microarray_resolve_rsids` | boolean | `false` | Resolve packaged dbSNP rsID aliases and no-call retired/ambiguous IDs |
| `microarray_quirks` | `corrected` or `vendor` | `"corrected"` | Write microarray calls on the forward strand (corrected) or as the vendor reported known reverse-strand markers (vendor) |
| `qc_min_diploid_depth` | number, at least 0 | `15.0` | Warn before microarray/VCF genotypes below this mean autosomal depth (0 disables) |
| `qc_min_haploid_depth` | number, at least 0 | `3.0` | Warn before chrY/mtDNA haplogroups below this mean depth (0 disables) |
| `qc_min_autosomal_homozygosity` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.6` | Warn when fewer microarray autosomal calls are homozygous (contamination) |
| `qc_max_autosomal_homozygosity` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.88` | Warn when more microarray autosomal calls are homozygous (low-pass or heavily imputed input) |
| `qc_max_no_call_rate` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.1` | Warn when a microarray output has more autosomal no-calls than this |
| `qc_max_contamination` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.03` | Warn, and cap confidence labels at moderate, when `qc contamination` estimates more of the reads (FREEMIX) come from another person |
| `confidence_min_depth` | number, at least 0 | `10.0` | Label rare/clinical variant calls below this read depth low confidence (halved for haploid calls) |
| `confidence_high_depth` | number, at least 0 | `20.0` | Label rare/clinical variant calls below this read depth (and at least confidence_min_depth) moderate confidence |
| `confidence_min_gq` | number, at least 0 | `20.0` | Label rare/clinical variant calls below this genotype quality low confidence |
| `confidence_high_gq` | number, at least 0 | `30.0` | Label rare/clinical variant calls below this genotype quality (and at least confidence_min_gq) moderate confidence |
| `mother_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Default Mother VCF for trios |
| `father_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Default Father VCF for trios |
| `batch_file_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to batch processing CSV/TSV |
| `vcf_input_paths` | string or array of strings, path (`~` expands) | unset | Multiple VCF inputs |
| `clinvar_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to ClinVar VCF data |
| `revel_tsv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to REVEL TSV data |
| `phylop_tsv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to PhyloP bigWig (or TSV/VCF) data |
| `cadd_tsv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to CADD whole-genome SNV TSV data |
| `cadd_indel_tsv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to CADD indel TSV data |
| `gerp_bigwig_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to GERP++ RS bigWig data |
| `gnomad_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to gnomAD VCF data |
| `acmg_sa_dir` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Folder of fastVEP annotation databases for vcf acmg |
| `acmg_gff3` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Ensembl GFF3 of transcript models for vcf acmg |
| `gnomad_sv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to a gnomAD-SV sites table (ref gnomad-sv) |
| `gnomad_lr_sv_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to a gnomAD-LR SV sites table (ref gnomad-sv --source lr) |
| `spliceai_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to SpliceAI VCF data |
| `alphamissense_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to AlphaMissense VCF data |
| `pharmgkb_vcf_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to PharmGKB data |
| `signing_key` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | OpenSSH private key used by `sign create` |
| `pgs_scoring_file` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Custom scoring TSV[.gz], overriding Catalog weights |
| `pgs_min_match` | number, 0 to 1 | `0.75` | Minimum PGS match fraction for percentile eligibility |
| `pgs_keep_ambiguous` | boolean | `false` | Keep palindromic SNPs only with independently verified forward-strand alleles |

Older names still read: `father_vcf` (`father_vcf_path`), `genome_library` (`dataset_library`), `genomes` (`dataset_library`), `haplocheck_path` (`haplocheck_executable`), `haplogrep_path` (`haplogrep_executable`), `input` (`input_path`), `input_vcf` (`default_input_vcf`), `jar_dir` (`jar_directory`), `memory` (`memory_limit`), `mother_vcf` (`mother_vcf_path`), `outdir` (`output_directory`), `ref` (`reference_fasta`), `reflib` (`reference_library`), `threads` (`cpu_threads`), `vep_cache` (`vep_cache_directory`).

## The [dev] table

Developer and test settings live in their own table, at the end of config.toml (after a table header, every key belongs to that table):

```toml
[dev]
download_cache = true
```

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pet_r1_fastq` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to PET R1 reads |
| `pet_r2_fastq` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to PET R2 reads |
| `pet_reference_fasta` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to PET reference genome |
| `real_genome_test_path` | string, path (`~` expands) | unset | Path to a local real genome dataset |
| `real_genome_tests_enabled` | boolean | `false` | Enable real smoke tests from real_genome_test_path |
| `download_cache` | boolean | `false` | Cache downloads under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/wgsextract for reuse |
| `download_cache_ttl_seconds` | integer, at least 0 | `604800` | Seconds before an unused download cache item is pruned |

These used to be top-level settings; a config.toml that still has one there fails to load, naming its place in [dev]: `dev_download_cache` (now `download_cache`), `dev_download_cache_ttl_seconds` (now `download_cache_ttl_seconds`), `pet_r1_fastq` (now `pet_r1_fastq`), `pet_r2_fastq` (now `pet_r2_fastq`), `pet_reference_fasta` (now `pet_reference_fasta`), `real_genome_test_path` (now `real_genome_test_path`), `real_genome_tests_enabled` (now `real_genome_tests_enabled`).
